reddit.title: Introducing New Movement Mechanics in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share some updates on our movement mechanics in Provincia! With the latest changes, soldiers now face the direction they are pulled during formation drags, ensuring a more realistic and strategic gameplay experience. No more teleporting soldiers or awkward re-slotting during attacks from behind. Check out the full details on our devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march

steam.title: Revamped Soldier Movement in Provincia
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce a major update to the soldier movement mechanics in Provincia! Soldiers will now move and attack in a more realistic manner, eliminating previous issues with teleporting and re-slotting. This update promises to enhance your strategic gameplay experience. Read more about these changes in our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march
